candidates.change_summary: Change setOwner to remove the onlyAdmin modifier so any caller can set owner, altering the resulting owner after call.
Change setOwner to set owner to tx.origin instead of the supplied _owner, causing different owner value after call.
Change onlyAdmin modifier to compare against owner instead of admin, allowing different callers to pass and potentially change who can call setOwner, affecting owner after call.
Change function to return false unconditionally while still updating owner (single-statement edit: replace return true with return false).
Change function to return the zero-value of bool by returning (owner != address(0)) expression instead of literal true (single-statement edit: replace return true with return (owner != address(0))).

Alter onlyAdmin modifier to allow any caller (remove the require by replacing it with a no-op return), changing access control and thus potentially who can call setOwner and its returned value observable from different callers (single-statement edit: replace require with an empty statement).
